description: This Java interface defines a builder for constructing topic paths related to search and command actions within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It provides methods to specify different action types such as subscribe, cancel, request, complete, failed, hasNext, and generated, each returning a buildable object for method chaining.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Sets the action to SUBSCRIBE, returning a buildable to chain further calls.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Sets the action to CANCEL, returning a buildable to chain further calls.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sets the action to REQUEST, returning a buildable to chain further calls.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Sets the action to COMPLETE, returning a buildable to chain further calls.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Sets the action to FAILED, returning a buildable to chain further calls.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Sets the action to NEXT, returning a buildable to chain further calls.

methods.name: generated
methods.description: Sets the action to GENERATED, returning a buildable to chain further calls.
